metadata.title: Assemble Dashboard Page with Three Numbers Grid

story.iWant: the dashboard to be my primary landing page with a three-column grid of financial health cards
story.soThat: I immediately see my financial health when I open the app

tasks.task: Create ThreeNumbersGrid component with responsive CSS Grid and entrance animations
Create date formatting utility (SA format DD/MM/YYYY) using date-fns
Create DashboardHeader component with title and formatted date
Create QuickActions component with Update Balances and View Comparison buttons
Create EmptyState component with friendly message and CTA
Update DashboardPage to assemble all components with conditional rendering
Write component tests for DashboardPage integration
Verify build and all tests pass

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I open the application, when the app loads, then I land on the Dashboard page (not a login screen or blank page)
Page header shows "Financial Health Dashboard" with current date in SA format (DD/MM/YYYY)
Three Numbers Grid displays: 3-column on desktop (≥1024px), 2-column on tablet (768px-1023px), 1-column on mobile (<768px)
Cards animate in with subtle fade (Tailwind animate-in, fade-in, slide-in-from-bottom)
Quick Actions section includes Update Balances button (to Data Entry) and View Full Comparison button (to Compare, disabled if no accounts)
All monetary values formatted as ZAR (R X,XXX.XX) using formatCurrency utility
Empty state shown if no financial data: friendly message, prompt to add account, CTA button to Data Entry
Loading state with skeleton placeholders for all three cards while data loads

constraints.constraint: Use Tailwind responsive classes: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 for responsive grid
Use tailwindcss-animate classes: animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500 for entrance animations
Stagger animation delays: delay-0, delay-100, delay-200 for visual sequence
Use uiStore.setCurrentPage() for navigation, NOT react-router
Use date-fns format() with 'dd/MM/yyyy' pattern for SA dates
Use useAccounts().accounts.length for empty state detection
Use semantic HTML: h1 for page title, time element for date display
Button disabled state must be visually indicated
All new components must have unit tests
Test responsive classes present, animation classes present
Bundle size currently at 638KB - monitor additions, avoid unnecessary imports
